summary: ## **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ## **Petition No. 812/RC/2025** ## **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** ## **Date of Order: 15[th] January, 2026** ## **In the matter of** Petition under Regulation 17 read with Regulation 56 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Power Market) Regulations, 2021 for seeking approval of appointment of Mr. Deepak Amitabh as an Independent Director on the Board of Power Exchange India Limited and seeking relaxation from the requirement of proposing two names for the said appointment. ## **And** ## **In the matter of** **Power Exchange India Limited,** 9[th] Floor, 901, Sumer Plaza, Marol Maroshi Road, Marol Andheri (East) - 400059, Mumbai. ** Petitioner** ## **ORDER** The Petitioner, Power Exchange India Limited, has filed the present Petition with the following prayers: “a. _Grant approval for appointment of Mr. Deepak Amitabh (DIN: 01061535) as an Independent Director on the Board of Power Exchange India Limited;_ _b. Relax the requirement under Regulation 17(3) of the PMR 2021 to propose two names, and permit submission of only one name i.e., Mr. Deepak Amitabh for the position of Independent Director, in exercise of power to relax under Regulation 56 of PMR 2021; and_ _c. Pass any such other relief(s)/ Order(s) that this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ 2. The Petitioner, vide its affidavit dated 9.1.2026, has sought permission to withdraw the present Petition on account of a change in circumstances. Order in Petition No. 812/RC/2025 Page 1 3. The Petition is being decided by circulation. In view of the submissions of the Petitioner, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present Petition. Accordingly, the present Petition is disposed of as withdrawn. 4. Petition No. 812/RC/2025 is disposed of in terms of the above. **Sd/sd/sd/sd/(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 812/RC/2025 Page 2 CERC Website S. No. 34/2026
